name: Survival Of Runt
detailed_description:
Born a Runt, Die a Legend.

They will ignore you.
They will laugh, certain you'll be the first to fall.
Because you were born a Runt—the weakest, the most insignificant.

But it is for that very reason your survival will become the greatest story ever told.

Now, rewrite the laws of survival in this ruthless world.

[Core Features]

 A Journey with an AI Companion Who Has a Soul
You are not alone in this hell. But can you truly trust your companion?
Our AI partners are not mere bots. They are true companions who can be hurt by your words, rejoice in your victories, and might even sacrifice themselves for you in a moment of desperation. Forge a bond through natural conversation and commands, and find your one and only ally in this world.

 Time is Your Life, and Your Ultimate Currency
In this world, your remaining 'Time' is not just a timer. It is your life, your hope, and sometimes, the most powerful resource to trade. 'Earn' time by completing quests, 'bet' time in perilous battles, and 'sacrifice' time for your comrades. The moment your time hits zero, you lose everything. What is the value of your single second?

 The Ever-Shrinking Battlefield of the Deadzone
Time devours all. Safe zones shrink by the second, and yesterday's allies are reborn as today's zombies, hunting you down. Will you cooperate to withstand the final wave, or betray everyone to be the last one standing? Every choice directly impacts your survival.

 An Endless War for Absolute Dominance: Conquest Mode
Survival for a day is not the end here. On a server-wide stage, conquer strategic points and plunder resources to expand your dominion. In a fierce psychological war and large-scale battles against other survivors, show them who the true ruler of this world is.

 Break Everything, Forge Your Own Path
Is your path blocked? Then tear down the wall. Is the enemy hiding? Then demolish the building. Every structure in this world can be destroyed and reshaped according to your strategy. Use the terrain itself as a weapon and create an unpredictable battlefield.

[A Promise for the Future]

 Your Story Becomes the History of This World (Future Update)
The tales of this land are not written by developers, but by YOU. One day, you will design your own quests, challenge other survivors with your own trials, and carve new legends into this desolate world. Are you a player in this world? Or are you its creator?

Begin your proof of survival. Now.

short_description: In this 3rd person zombie survival shooter, you'll plunder everything in an ever-shrinking deadzone and conquer territories on a server wide stage. But here, your playtime itself is the final resource for survival. Complete quests to earn more time, win your battles, and become the last one standing

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 / RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-11600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is set in a zombie survival environment and includes violent depictions such as bloodstains and dismemberment.
It does not contain any content related to sexual assault, non-consensual sexual acts, explicit sexual behavior, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
Players who are sensitive to violent content are advised to take this into consideration when playing the game.
